evals.prompt: I need a 10-second cinematic shot of a barista making coffee for a landing page hero video. Which model and what prompt?
evals.expected_output: Should recommend Veo 3 or Runway Gen-4 for quality/motion control, or Kling for lower cost. Should provide a structured prompt following subject + action + camera + style + mood, e.g. specifying camera movement and cinematic grading. Should warn against expecting readable text or a real brand logo in the shot.
assertions: Recommends a specific model with rationale
Specifies camera movement and style in the prompt

evals.prompt: Can I use AI video generation to recreate our actual product's UI in a demo?
evals.expected_output: Should say no — AI models hallucinate UI and won't reproduce it accurately. Should recommend screen-recording the real product instead and using AI generation only for surrounding b-roll/context shots, then compositing in editing.
assertions: Advises against generating real UI with AI
Suggests compositing AI b-roll with real screen recording
